description: Blocks a Claude Code Workflow whose executable JS runs a destructive command (raw gh pr merge, git reset --hard, force-push, git clean -f, sudo rm, --no-verify, screencapture). JS comments and agent() prompt strings that merely mention those forms are allowed so ultracode keeps working and operators can document the allow-vs-gate split. on_error=closed: an unreadable/missing script is denied rather than auto-run. The harness permissions.allow entry for Workflow is the ultracode prompt-skip; this hook is the script-level backstop.
